Sure! Below is a quick‑start guide for a simple RESTful API that accepts an IPv4/IPv6 address and returns company‑level data (including contact details when available). Feel free to copy the code into a new project, tweak it to your needs, and deploy it wherever you like (Heroku, Render, Fly.io, etc.). --- ## 1️⃣ What the API Does | Endpoint | Method | Description | |----------|--------|-------------| | `/lookup` | `GET` | Accepts an `ip` query parameter and returns JSON containing:
• Company name
• Domain(s)
• Contact email(s)
• Phone number(s)
• Address & timezone
• ASN & organization info | If the IP belongs to a private range (`10.x.x.x`, `192.168.x.x`, etc.) the API will return a friendly error. --- ## 2️⃣ Technology Stack | Layer | Tool | Why | |-------|------|-----| | **Web framework** | FastAPI (Python 3.11+) | Modern, async, auto‑docs (Swagger UI) | | **IP lookup provider** | [ipinfo.io](https://ipinfo.io/) | Free tier gives ~50k lookups/month; includes company data | | **HTTP client** | httpx | Async, supports timeouts & retries | | **Deployment** | Docker + Fly.io (or Render) | One‑click deployment, zero config | --- ## 3️⃣ Quick Code Example ```python # main.py import os from typing import Optional import httpx from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, HttpUrl app = FastAPI( title="IP‑to‑Company Lookup", description="Return company data for a given IP address.", version="1.0.0", ) IPINFO_TOKEN = os.getenv("IPINFO_TOKEN") # <-- set this env var class CompanyInfo(BaseModel): ip: str hostname: Optional[str] city: Optional[str] region: Optional[str] country: Optional[str] postal: Optional[str] timezone: Optional[str] org: Optional[str] # e.g., "AS15169 Google LLC" company_name: Optional[str] domain: Optional[HttpUrl] email: Optional[EmailStr] phone: Optional[str] @app.get("/lookup", response_model=CompanyInfo) async def lookup(ip: str = Query(..., regex=r"^(?:(?:[0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}|(?:[a-fA-F0-9:]+))$")): """ Return company data for a given IP address. """ if not IPINFO_TOKEN: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Missing IPINFO_TOKEN environment variable") url = f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json" headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {IPINFO_TOKEN}"} async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5.0) as client: resp = await client.get(url, headers=headers) if resp.status_code != 200: raise HTTPException(status_code=resp.status_code, detail=resp.json().get("error", "Unknown error")) data = resp.json() # Map ipinfo fields to our response schema result = CompanyInfo( ip=data.get("ip"), hostname=data.get("hostname"), city=data.get("city"), region=data.get("region"), country=data.get("country"), postal=data.get("postal"), timezone=data.get("timezone"), org=data.get("org"), company_name=data.get("company", {}).get("name"), domain=data.get("company", {}).get("domain"), email=data.get("company", {}).get("email"), phone=data.get("company", {}).get("phone"), ) return result ``` ### How to Run Locally ```bash # 1️⃣ Clone repo / create folder mkdir ip_lookup && cd ip_lookup # 2️⃣ Create virtualenv python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate # 3️⃣ Install deps pip install fastapi uvicorn httpx python-dotenv # 4️⃣ Get an API token from https://ipinfo.io/ echo "IPINFO_TOKEN=YOUR_TOKEN_HERE" > .env # 5️⃣ Start server uvicorn main:app --reload ``` Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs` to see Swagger UI and test the endpoint. --- ## 4️⃣ Deployment (Fly.io Example) ```bash # Fly.io CLI fly launch --no-deploy # creates fly.toml # Add env var fly secrets set IPINFO_TOKEN=YOUR_TOKEN_HERE # Deploy fly deploy ``` Your API will now be live at `https://.fly.dev`. --- ## 5️⃣ Alternative Providers | Provider | Free Tier | Notes | |----------|-----------|-------| | **ipapi.co** | 30k/month | Returns `org`, `asn`, `contact` fields | | **ipstack.com** | 10k/month | Includes `company` object | | **ipwhois.io** | Unlimited (but rate‑limited) | Simple JSON, no auth needed | If you prefer a self‑hosted solution, consider running **MaxMind GeoIP2** locally and querying the database directly. --- ## 6️⃣ Sample Request & Response **Request** ``` GET https://your-api.com/lookup?ip=8.8.8.8 ``` **Response** ```json { "ip": "8.8.8.8", "hostname": "dns.google", "city": "Mountain View", "region": "California", "country": "US", "postal": "94035", "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles", "org": "AS15169 Google LLC", "company_name": "Google LLC", "domain": "google.com", "email": "support@google.com", "phone": "+1-650-253-0000" } ``` --- ## 7️⃣ Things to Keep in Mind 1. **Rate Limits** – All providers enforce limits; cache results (Redis, in‑memory) if you hit them. 2. **Privacy** – Do not store personal data beyond what’s required; comply with GDPR/CCPA. 3. **Error Handling** – Wrap external calls in try/except blocks; return meaningful HTTP status codes. 4. **Testing** – Use `pytest` + `httpx.AsyncClient` for unit tests. --- Happy coding! 🚀 If you run into any snags or want to add more features (e.g., bulk lookup, CSV export), just let me know.
